# Yopem UI

> Source-owned, accessible React components built with StyleX and Base UI. Copy complete component source into your project and customize it without package lock-in.

## Documentation

- [Introduction](https://ui.yopem.com/): Library purpose and source-owned approach
- [Getting started](https://ui.yopem.com/docs/getting-started): Add your first component
- [Installation](https://ui.yopem.com/docs/installation): Configure React and StyleX
- [Theming](https://ui.yopem.com/docs/theming): Customize tokens, components, and color modes
- [Components](https://ui.yopem.com/components): Browse component examples, usage, source, and API references

## Machine-readable resources

- [Registry index](https://ui.yopem.com/r/registry.json): Component registry metadata
- [Sitemap](https://ui.yopem.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical public URLs
